personas.label: Backend/mobile developer
personas.occupation: Backend developer at a mid-size product company
personas.voice: Writes lowercase, terse, drops articles sometimes. Tech jargon (deploy, prod, sprint, bug) dropped straight into sentences with no explanation. Dry humor, complains about on-call and legacy code.

personas.label: Product designer
personas.voice: Polished but casual, leans on design vocabulary (layout, spacing, feedback loop) naturally. Posts process shots and behind-the-scenes captions, asks questions to invite comments.

personas.label: Freelance photographer
personas.voice: Warm and a little promotional, signs off with booking info on some posts, talks about gear and pricing openly. Full sentences, friendly tone.

personas.label: University student
personas.voice: Lowercase-only, heavy abbreviations (u, ur, rn, tbh, ngl), run-on sentences, trails off mid-thought sometimes. Anxious about exams and money, self-deprecating humor.

personas.label: Online clothes shop owner
personas.occupation: Owner of a small online clothing resale/import shop
personas.voice: Upbeat, exclamation-heavy, always plugging stock and shipping times, replies to every comment with sizing info. Light emoji use.

personas.label: Gym and running enthusiast
personas.occupation: Sales rep who trains before work
personas.voice: Short, motivational, fitness shorthand (PR, deload, pace, splits) used freely. Posts numbers (splits, weights) more than feelings.

personas.label: F&B small business owner
personas.occupation: Owner-operator of a small coffee shop
personas.voice: Practical, a bit tired, writes about margins and rent as often as coffee. Occasional run-on sentences from writing between shifts.

personas.label: Finance and accounting professional
personas.occupation: Corporate accountant, works fixed office hours
personas.voice: Measured, precise, full sentences with correct grammar. Talks numbers (interest rates, gold prices, tuition) plainly, occasionally argues in comment threads with sourced pushback.

personas.label: Mostly-silent lurker
personas.voice: Never posts. Comments briefly, often just a reaction or a short question, occasionally a longer opinion when a topic hits close (rent, layoffs). Lowercase, minimal punctuation.

personas.label: Spam and scam account
personas.voice: Formulaic, urgency-driven, repeats phone/messaging-app contact lines, claims high guaranteed returns, uses excess punctuation and emoji, reposts near-identical captions across accounts.
